How it all began

OUR STORY

CHAPTER I

The First Spark

two hearts, one unexpected beginning

Some love stories are written in the stars, while others begin with a simple conversation. Ours began with two people who never knew that a meeting could change everything. What started as a little spark soon became something beautiful — a feeling that brought two hearts closer and made the ordinary moments feel extraordinary.

CHAPTER II

Our Kind of Love

from strangers to soulmates

With every conversation, every laugh, and every little moment, we found more reasons to choose each other. We became each other's comfort, biggest cheerleader, and favourite person. Through distance, busy days, and countless memories, our bond grew stronger — turning a beautiful beginning into a love we knew was worth a lifetime.

CHAPTER III

Forever Starts Here

one promise, a lifetime of us

And now, our favourite chapter begins. Two hearts, two families, and one beautiful promise to walk through life hand in hand. We are ready to turn our dreams into memories, our promises into forever, and our love story into a lifetime of togetherness. This isn't the end of our story — it's the beginning of our forever.
